cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard shadows, cool institutional palette with one warm accent. The dive hall seen from the doorway at low angle, as if the viewer has just walked in: two long couches under a low ceiling of black cabling, strip lighting, the handle board glowing pale on the far wall. On the near couch, Kirisu Wataru — PIKE — sprawled sideways with a drink and a straw, one eye covered, grinning at something. Standing over him with one hand on the couch back, mid-sentence, is Kanade in dive kit with her hair already down: tower silhouette, in a ground-floor room. Both of them have just looked up toward the viewer. In the extreme foreground, out of focus and cut by the frame edge, the back of Kou's head and one shoulder — solid black hair, the darkest mass in the image, filling the bottom-left corner. He has stopped in the doorway. The composition is entirely about the fact that a conversation was already happening.

chars.name: kanade

chars.expression: flat, and underneath it properly rattled

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: alone in the room, tablet in her lap, saying it to a closed door

panels.bg: the dorm, the shut door, printouts, grey light, flat tone

chars.expression: rendered, settling, handing him a drink without being asked

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking it

chars.name: gen

panels.bg: the road, low sun, flat tone, close

chars.name: kou

chars.name: shizu

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — hands only

chars.name: shizu

chars.name: kou

chars.name: shizu

chars.name: kou

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: eating, level, delivering it as a technical note

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eating, listening

panels.bg: the flat, two bowls, one lamp, night window

dialogue.text: Then stop taking hits for a while.

I did fourteen of them. Stop taking hits.

panels.action: Thursday. Same time Thursday.

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: absolutely nothing on his face, the mild one and the flat one at the same time

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: brisk, professional, entirely pleased with herself

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking it

chars.name: pike

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: pike

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: pike

chars.pose: braced, three shapes breaking on him

panels.bg: the quarry ledge, pale shapes hitting a broad arc of light, dust, hard focus lines

dialogue.text: That's the good stuff. Come on then.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: cutting clean, and with room to move for the first time in a year

panels.bg: the quarry, shapes coming apart, pale stone, motes

chars.name: kanade

chars.pose: on the ledge, hands still lit

chars.name: pike

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, applauding sarcastically

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, sheathing

dialogue.text: THE WALL HOLDS. The wall has never not held.
You fell over on twenty-eight.
The wall RELOCATED.
Downward.

chars.name: pike

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou

Mm.

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: entirely unbothered, straw in mouth

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: listening, grinning at the delivery

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: cheerful, timing it perfectly, one eye covered

panels.bg: close, the terrace, flat tone

dialogue.text: Being startled. Then finding things funny.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the grin gone in about a quarter of a second

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: grinning, pointing at her face

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing off to one side, back turned, not part of this

dialogue.text: There. That's the bit where people go quiet. Never fails.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sheathing the sword — and it does not seat first time
chars.pose: hand on the grip, re-seating it

dialogue.text: So then Kettle asks me — she asks if I'm free Thursdays—

Four months.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — hand only

chars.name: kanade

dialogue.text: He did that twice.

...Probably nothing. Long night. Everyone's tired.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: mid-anecdote, arms out, oblivious

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not listening to a word of it now

dialogue.text: —and she says 'I flatten it', like that's a job description!

chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, half-turned back

chars.expression: mild

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, and underneath it something that has been sat on for two years

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kanade

chars.name: kou

chars.name: kou

panels.action: Riko has been awake since midnight and will not mention that.

dialogue.text: How did it go.
Thirty-four in twenty-six minutes.
That's not what I asked.
I know it isn't.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arm over her eyes, talking at the ceiling

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: listening

panels.bg: the dorm, lamp, dark window
panels.action: She lays it out like a report, because that is how she processes anything.

dialogue.text: The plan worked. Nothing touched him for twenty-six minutes.
He said it was a good dive. Then he said I did something to him.
Not for him. To him. He was very precise about it.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: going very carefully, because she has wanted to say this for eleven years

panels.bg: the dorm, lamp, flat tone, close
panels.action: Riko investigates because she loves someone and it is her job. This is the other half of that job.

dialogue.text: Kanade. Can I say a thing you won't like.
You're going to anyway.
I've been going to for about eleven years.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: flat, kind, and absolutely unflinching

panels.bg: the dorm room, one lamp, everything else dropping to flat dark tone
panels.action: The hook, and it is one sentence.

dialogue.text: You did to him exactly what your father does to you.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arm coming off her eyes very slowly

panels.bg: the dorm ceiling, lamp light, flat tone
panels.action: Eleven years. Nobody has ever said it in a room she was in.

dialogue.text: That's not—
'She'd only argue. Just get it arranged.'
Your father said that in front of me when we were twelve.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: not letting up, because letting up would be the unkind option

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting up now

panels.bg: dorm, lamp, dark window
panels.action: She lists it like a log, which is the only way Kanade will hear it.

dialogue.text: Your tutor. Your affinity stream. The ban.
The ban, Kanade. They decided that for your own good.
You've broken it forty-two times.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the whole thing landing at once, and it is not a nice arrival

panels.bg: flat tone, lamp light, close
panels.action: It is not that she was wrong about the plan. The plan was excellent. That is the worst part.

dialogue.text: It was a good plan.
The ban was a good plan.
Oh.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: sitting back, done, and immediately worried she went too far
chars.pose: pulling the tablet back onto her knees

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: staring at the wall

panels.bg: the dorm, lamp, tone wash
panels.action: Riko has been carrying that for eleven years and it took nine seconds to put down.

dialogue.text: I'm not saying don't help him.
I know what you're saying.
...Sorry.
Don't. That was the useful one.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, seated on the bed edge, head down

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, on the other bed, facing her

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid black figures against a flat pale tone field, the window a hard rectangle between them, the lamp a single white circle. No features.
panels.action: Two o'clock in the morning, and one of them has just been shown the shape of herself.

dialogue.text: Riko.
Mm.
How do you apologise for a thing that worked?
You don't apologise for the plan. Try the other bit.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: enormous, blocking the classroom doorway, holding a bag of bread

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, arriving

panels.bg: the classroom corridor, Friday morning, tall windows, students, tone-washed
panels.action: Friday. Nine hours to half seven.

dialogue.text: You look like a man who lost an argument.
I didn't lose it.
Oh, so you HAD one. That's new. That's a whole new thing.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: chibi, notebook out, pencil poised, investigative

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, walking into the classroom

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. He is not actually going to investigate. He never does.

dialogue.text: An argument! With a PERSON! Who? Where? Was it loud?
You said you weren't asking any more.
I SAID THAT ON SATURDAY. It's Friday. Different week.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: rendered, dropping it instantly, holding out the bread bag

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking a piece

panels.bg: the classroom, desks, morning light
panels.action: He drops it in about a second and a half, every single time.

dialogue.text: Fine. Don't tell me. Have some bread.
...Thanks.
It's the melon one. You never say anything about it, but it's the melon one.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: holding a piece of bread, mild, and something behind the eyes

panels.bg: the desk, the bread, morning light, flat tone
panels.action: Two years of the melon one. He has never once been able to tell.

dialogue.text: He's brought me the melon one twice a week for two years.
I told him I liked it in first year, because he looked hopeful.
I have never known what it tastes like. Not once.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: coming in, public smile on, saying good morning to three people on the way

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eating bread, not looking up

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: waving at her

panels.bg: classroom 2-B, morning light, students, the Tower in the window
panels.action: Four desks. Two years. Same room.

dialogue.text: Ariake-san! You look tired!
Committee papers. Nothing exciting.
Morning, Hazama-kun.
Morning.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting down four desks away, smile still on, eyes doing arithmetic

panels.bg: classroom, window light, blurred students
panels.action: Two hundred and twelve people have decided things for her without asking. She has a list.

dialogue.text: Sentence twelve. 'Morning, Hazama-kun.'
And Thursday I put a whole person on his dive without asking.
And I'd have done it again on Tuesday if Riko hadn't—

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: rumpled, at the front with a folder, addressing the room

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already half-standing

panels.bg: classroom 2-B, morning, students at desks, tone wash
panels.action: Somebody has to do the harness returns. It is always the same somebody.

dialogue.text: Harness returns before lunch. Volunteers.
Hazama does it.
I'll—

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hand up, smile on, doing something in front of twenty-eight people

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: surprised

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: blinking

panels.bg: the classroom, all heads turning, morning light
panels.action: First in the year has never volunteered for anything that was not on a form.

dialogue.text: I'll do it, sensei.
...Ariake?
I've never done a return log. I should know how.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: half out of his seat, and entirely unable to read this

panels.bg: the classroom, blurred, flat tone
panels.action: He does not know whether this is another arrangement or the opposite of one.

dialogue.text: That's the third time this week she's done something at me.
I genuinely can't tell if this one's the same thing.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing, gathering the log sheets, and looking straight at him for the first time in daylight
chars.pose: at the front of the room

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: still half out of his chair

panels.bg: classroom 2-B, twenty-eight people, morning light, the Tower in the window
panels.action: In front of the entire class, she asks him instead of arranging him.

dialogue.text: Hazama-kun. You've done it before, haven't you.
Would you show me how? If you've got time.

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: staring, entirely thrown

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: mouth open, bread halfway to it

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing up

panels.bg: the classroom, twenty-eight faces, morning light
panels.action: Nobody in this room has ever heard anybody ask Hazama for anything.

dialogue.text: ...Him?
He does it every week. He'll be quicker than the manual.
He IS quicker than the manual. That's actually true.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, and the answer is not automatic for once

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: waiting, and visibly making herself wait

panels.bg: the classroom aisle, students, morning light
panels.action: She asks and then does not fill the gap. She has to physically make herself not fill the gap.

dialogue.text: Wait. Wait. Don't do it for him. Wait.
...Yeah. Okay.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking beside him down the corridor with a clipboard, entirely ordinary

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking

panels.bg: the third-floor corridor toward the training hall, tall windows, students, tone-washed
panels.action: Ten metres of corridor, in public, in daylight, on purpose.

dialogue.text: That's an apology, by the way.
Is it.
Riko says I'm not allowed to apologise for the plan.
So that's the other bit. That's what the other bit looks like.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: a very small real smile, second in the series

panels.bg: the corridor, window light, tone wash, soft bokeh
panels.action: She asked him a question in front of twenty-eight people and then waited nine seconds for the answer.

dialogue.text: Pike stays.
...Really?
It's a better shape. You were right about the shape.
You were just wrong about the asking.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, fists up, vindicated and simultaneously chastened

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, walking on

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch, in a school corridor, in front of everybody.

dialogue.text: I was RIGHT about the shape. Say it louder.
Wrong about the asking.
SAY THE FIRST HALF LOUDER.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, in the equipment storeroom, clipboard up, entirely at home

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: on a crate with the log book

panels.bg: the equipment storeroom, one bare bulb, steel shelving, the door open this time onto the training hall
panels.action: Same room as Chapter 2. The door is open and neither of them notices that it is.

dialogue.text: Fourteen. Fifteen. This is unbelievably boring.
It's forty minutes a week.
You do this every week? Voluntarily?
Nobody else wants it. It's quiet.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: handing a harness down to him off the shelf

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking it

panels.bg: the storeroom, shelving, bare bulb
panels.action: It is the least dramatic thing that has happened in four chapters.

dialogue.text: Sixteen. Catch.
Got it.
You always say that. On every single dive.
It's usually true.
It's always been true. That's rather the point of it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — hands only
chars.pose: the harness webbing slipping through his fingers and landing on the floor

panels.bg: the storeroom floor, the dropped harness, the bare bulb overhead, hard close
panels.action: He was holding it. He was definitely holding it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: picking it up, entirely unbothered, already moving on

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: gone very still up on the step-stool

panels.bg: the storeroom, shelving, bare bulb
panels.action: Second time. She counted the first one on layer thirty-four.

dialogue.text: Sorry. Wet hands.
...Your hands aren't wet.
Webbing's slippy. They do that.
Mm.
Seventeen?
...Seventeen.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: up on the step-stool, holding a harness, not looking down at him, face doing nothing

panels.bg: the storeroom shelving, the bare bulb, everything below her out of focus, hard flat tone at the frame edges
panels.action: Final panel. Pike explained the order out loud on layer thirty-four and she was sitting right there.

dialogue.text: Six to ten, you stop feeling weather and grip.
He's on ten. That's what ten is.
So what's eleven.
